baseline_sources.deployment_context: Consumer ChatGPT client applications on iOS and macOS, including conversation access, sign-up, sign-in, account creation, and password update flows.
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: OpenAI Status reports its own experience, finding, service state or action; the status is bounded to that first-party account.
baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Relied on for OpenAI's represented incident scope, update chronology, mitigation states and recovery; not relied on for an unpublished technical root cause or affected-user count.

primary_artefact_access.access_method: Direct review of the public OpenAI Status incident page
limitations: The page reports OpenAI's service observations and response but does not disclose technical root cause or affected-user count.

baseline_sources.relevance_note: Official evidence of a client-specific access incident where an authorization-coded user-facing error appeared during broader conversation and authentication degradation.
baseline_sources.source_context: OpenAI reported possible 403 errors for iOS conversations at 9:49 AM, later expanded scope to conversation, sign-up and sign-in errors on iOS and macOS, restored conversations at 12:34 PM and sign-in at 1:09 PM, applied mitigation for remaining account-creation and password-update errors at 3:15 PM, and declared full recovery at 3:28 PM.
